dedupe_keys.name: mantis ai real time digital twin for wastewater treatment facilities hydromantis

description: Mantis.AI is Hydromantis's digital twin tool for real-time forecasting and optimisation of wastewater treatment facilities, built on top of its SimuWorks operator training platform. It has four components: a cloud data platform that retrieves SCADA data and cleans and analyses it with machine learning, a process model of the plant built in the GPS-X simulation platform, a cloud visualisation system showing live SCADA trends and forecasts, and analysis and forecasting tools that flag upcoming problems, give troubleshooting suggestions and show how to cut energy or improve effluent quality. It uses live weather data, past plant performance and AI to forecast influent and environmental conditions for the next hours or days, can integrate collection system, pumping, distribution, water treatment and control models, and can be extended to predictive maintenance. Coverage: any treatment plant, site-specific, built plant by plant. Access: commercial product sold by the vendor; pricing is not shown on the page read, and the licence is proprietary. Caveats: this record rests on the vendor's product page, with no independent performance evidence. It supports digital twin and operational forecasting studies of wastewater plants, and relates to the GPS-X modelling platform in the catalogue.
